text:
Elena: kicked off a 2% canary for model v12-int4 on /generate focused on long-docs (>1800 tokens). Quick smoke shows a factuality uptick in that cohort.
Marco: paste the quick numbers?
Elena: short snapshot:
```
long-docs:\n  baseline(v11-fp16): factuality_fail=3.0%, mrr=0.867
  v12-int4:         factuality_fail=5.1% (+2.1pp), mrr=0.858 (-0.009)
short-docs: negligible
compute: ~-17% token-cpu
```
Zoe: +2.1pp on long-docs is right at our 2.0pp gate. Are kv-cache hits different?
TelemetryBot: kv_hit long-docs baseline=88.0% -> v12-int4=83.0% (-5.0pp).
Marco: cache drop aligns with factuality. Proposal: reduce to 0.5% now, pin long-docs to baseline, and run a seeded 50k long-doc eval with severity buckets. Also spin v12-fp16 quick build to isolate quantization.
Elena: agreed. I'll update routing and start the seeded job. Add an auto-fallback rule: long-doc factuality delta >= 2.0pp -> immediate reroute to baseline; MRR drop >=1.0% -> hold and notify.
Infra: Canary throttle executed at 5523456795: 2% -> 0.5%. Routing rule applied: long-doc cohort pinned to v11-fp16. Shadowing for v12-int4 remains enabled. Seeded eval queued.
Zoe: I'll instrument per-layer kv eviction heatmap. If we see eviction spikes concentrated on middle layers we can try per-layer mixed-quant as next step.
Elena: timeline: preliminary seeded results in ~4h, full run overnight. Will post artifacts here. :eyes:
